facts.fact: In LocaliQ (with WordStream) customer campaign data across Google Ads and Microsoft Ads, the average cost per click for search advertising across all industries in 2026 is $5.42.
facts.quote: The average CPC for search advertising across all industries in 2026 is $5.42.

facts.fact: In LocaliQ's 2026 benchmark data, Arts and Entertainment had the lowest average cost per click of the industries listed, at $1.63.
facts.quote: The lowest average cost per click came from Arts and Entertainment at $1.63

facts.fact: In LocaliQ's 2026 benchmark data, Restaurants & Food had an average cost per click of $2.05.
facts.quote: Restaurants and Food was close behind at only $2.05 per click.

facts.fact: In LocaliQ's 2026 benchmark data, the average click-through rate for search advertising across industries is 6.64%.
facts.quote: The average CTR for search advertising in 2026 across industries is 6.64%.

facts.fact: In LocaliQ's 2026 benchmark data, Arts & Entertainment had an average click-through rate of 12.75%.
In LocaliQ's 2026 benchmark data, Finance & Insurance had an average click-through rate of 9.83%.
In LocaliQ's 2026 benchmark data, Travel had an average click-through rate of 9.32%.
In LocaliQ's 2026 benchmark data, the average cost per lead for search advertising is $66.69.
facts.quote: The average CPL for search advertising in 2026 is $66.69.

facts.fact: In LocaliQ's benchmark data, cost per lead decreased overall across all industries for the first time in five years.
facts.quote: cost per lead decreased overall for the first time in five years.

facts.fact: In LocaliQ's 2026 benchmark data, the average conversion rate for Google Ads across industries is 8.18%.
facts.quote: The average conversion rate for Google Ads in 2026 across industries is 8.18%.

facts.fact: In LocaliQ's 2026 benchmark data, Animals & Pets had an average conversion rate of 16.22%.
In LocaliQ's 2026 benchmark data, Apparel / Fashion & Jewelry had an average conversion rate of 4.50%.
In LocaliQ's 2026 benchmark data, Attorneys & Legal Services had an average conversion rate of 5.55%.
LocaliQ defines the search advertising conversion rate as the number of leads divided by clicks.
facts.quote: The conversion rate for search advertising is determined by the number of leads you get divided by clicks.

facts.fact: LocaliQ defines a lead for cost-per-lead purposes as a user who clicks an ad and contacts the business by phone, chat, form fill, or email.
facts.quote: whether by phone, chat, form fill, or email.
